note: Rubrics are unlocked drafts. A person locks them. The signature (criteria, blind setting, redaction version) is created by the system.

criteria.name: API and service development
criteria.definition: Builds and maintains server side APIs and services that other software or teams use.

anchors.1: No evidence about api and service development in the resume, or only a bare keyword in a skills list with no activity described.
anchors.3: Describes a concrete duty in api and service development (what was actually done) but gives no scale, no measurable result and no ownership.
anchors.5: Shows owned or led work in api and service development with measured results, sustained over time, that others rely on or that grew other people.

criteria.interview_question: Tell me about a specific time you handled api and service development and what changed because of it.
